state.paragraph: On August 7, 2014, a representative of Industry Participant contacted a representative of J.P. Morgan. The Industry Participant representative indicated that she had heard rumors that J.P. Morgan was working with the Company and wanted to inform J.P. Morgan that, if the Company were to pursue strategic alternatives, Industry Participant might be interested in re-visiting the conversations that had taken place in the Spring concerning the feasibility of a possible combination of the two Companies. The J.P. Morgan representative reported the conversation to the ad hoc committee.

ledger_rows.Note: Board formed the ad hoc committee (Josefowicz, Gangwal, Stemberg) and authorized vetting and retention of a financial advisor; focus on capital-structure alternatives.
Filed Schedule 13D disclosing a 9.9% stake; advocated a sale in amendments and letters through August; met the Company on 07/10.
Public letter urged the board to consider a sale; offered to roll over part of its holdings if needed; met directors and management in May.
Company's financial advisor; retained in July after interviews; engagement letter effective 08/21/2014.
Called J.P. Morgan: might revisit a combination if the Company pursued alternatives; reported to the ad hoc committee.
Board determined to explore strategic alternatives including a possible sale; Profit Improvement Plan; ad hoc committee to oversee; J.P. Morgan to contact parties later.
Press release announced exploration of strategic alternatives including a possible sale; uncontacted parties could approach J.P. Morgan.

contact.instructions: `paragraph` reports that the target or its banker contacts potential buyers, or a potential buyer approaches the target, including counts of parties contacted. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
